story.title: Squirrel
paragraphs_en: A squirrel jumps here and there.
The squirrel goes here and there.
The squirrel climbs up the tree. The squirrel swings on the branch.
The squirrel goes to the roof. The squirrel comes to the garden.
The squirrel eats a nut and gets happy!
